T: Be nice. Until it's time to eat.
D: A professional bar cooler is hired to clean up the roughest roadhouse in Missouri.
P: Serve the snacks when Dalton takes over the Double Deuce.
S: Wings dried overnight and baked until crisp, tossed in hot sauce butter, served with a chunky blue cheese dip and cold celery sticks. Leave 1kg chicken wings uncovered in the fridge overnight, then toss with 1 tbsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 100ml hot sauce. Mash 100g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Toss the hot wings in the sauce and serve with the dip and celery sticks.

Halved jalapeños packed with cream cheese, cheddar and smoked paprika, wrapped in streaky bacon and baked until crisp, with a cool ranch dip. Halve 12 jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds. Beat 200g cream cheese with 60g grated cheddar and half a tsp smoked paprika and pack into the halves. Wrap each in half a rasher of streaky bacon and pin with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp. Mix 150g sour cream with chopped chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for a dip.
the loft on Emmet's farm by the river
Cucumbers packed into jars with garlic, dill and peppercorns in a hot vinegar brine, pickled a week, with sharp cheddar.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar, garlic and cayenne, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with a tomato and molasses barbecue sauce under the grill.

Rump steak seared hard in cast iron and basted with garlic thyme butter, with a baked potato loaded with sour cream, bacon and chives, and a green salad. Rub 4 large potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200C for 1 hour. Season 4 rump steaks and sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 3 minutes. Flip, add 50g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for 3 minutes for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes. Split the potatoes and top with sour cream, crisp bacon and chives. Serve with a green salad dressed in oil and vinegar.
W: Jasper, Missouri, the Double Deuce's town
A St Louis classic: cake base under a rich, gooey butter and cream cheese layer, dusted with icing sugar.
K: the bar behind the chicken wire stage

Bourbon poured over ice with fresh lime and a dash of bitters, topped with spicy ginger beer and finished with a lime wedge. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Pour 45ml bourbon into each and squeeze in a lime wedge. Add a dash of aromatic bitters to each glass. Top with 150ml cold ginger beer and give it one gentle stir. Garnish with a fresh lime wedge and serve straight away while the band plays.

s.note: the loft on Emmet's farm by the river
s.how: Pack 500g small cucumbers into a jar with 2 garlic cloves, dill and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over 250ml hot white vinegar boiled with 250ml water and 1 tbsp salt. Pickle a week. Serve with 200g sharp cheddar.

m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, garlic and a pinch of cayenne. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Simmer 150ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp molasses, brush on and glaze under the grill.

w.note: Jasper, Missouri, the Double Deuce's town
w.how: Mix 250g butter cake mix with 1 egg and 60g melted butter and press into a 20 by 30cm tin. Beat 250g cream cheese, 2 eggs, 1 tsp vanilla and 300g icing sugar, pour over and bake at 175C for 40 minutes. Cool and dust with icing sugar.
